questions.q: Why does the platform need a write-up at all, given that Theo already knows everything that happened?
options: It doesn't — the pull requests are sufficient documentation on their own
The next engineer who touches this app, and even Theo himself later, weren't in the room for every Slack thread and decision — the write-up makes it discoverable
It's only required for legal compliance reasons
Documentation is only useful before a project ships, not after
questions.explain: Pull requests and Slack threads aren't discoverable later; a single write-up makes the whole platform understandable to someone who wasn't there.

questions.q: What does the document say about changing the scaling profile in the future?
options: It should be edited directly on the live HPA whenever needed
Change it only via the module's profile_name argument in a reviewed pull request, never by editing the live HPA directly
The scaling profile should never be changed under any circumstances
Only Casey Lindqvist is authorized to change it
questions.explain: The documented process keeps the change going through source control and review, the same discipline Lesson 12's fix followed.

questions.q: What is the honest way to document the autoscaling mistake?
options: Vaguely describe it as 'a small configuration adjustment was made'
Describe it as a catastrophic security breach to emphasize its seriousness
State plainly what was wrong, why it happened, how it was found, and how it was fixed and verified
Omit it from the documentation entirely since it was already fixed
questions.explain: Honest documentation neither soft-pedals the mistake into meaninglessness nor overdramatizes a caught-and-fixed issue into something it wasn't.

questions.q: Why must the guardrail's override path be documented, not just the check itself?
options: It doesn't need documentation since the code is self-explanatory
Without clear documentation, a future engineer who hits a blocked merge has no way to know whether to fix the value or apply the peak-season-override label
The override path is a secret feature not meant to be used
Only the guardrail's failure message matters, not how to resolve it
questions.explain: An undocumented guardrail that blocks a merge with no clear explanation just looks like a broken pipeline to the next person who encounters it.

questions.q: What does the document say about the S3 bucket policy incident's actual impact?
options: Confirmed unauthorized access occurred and customer data was stolen
It was caught during the same review pass, before any confirmed unauthorized access
The bucket was taken offline permanently as a precaution
No fix was ultimately needed
questions.explain: The honest account states the issue was caught and fixed before any confirmed unauthorized access — accurate, not minimized or exaggerated.
